personality_one_liner: A premium, calm, and trustworthy financial memory that puts users in deterministic control of their money without cognitive overload.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for financial data. Keep list items at least 56pt high. Empty space should feel intentional.

do's: Bottom tab bar (when content scrolls behind it)
Modal scrim entry/exit for bottom sheets
dont's: Dense data cards in the Financial Control screen

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A premium dashboard offering an immediate sense of financial control, current balances, and quick capture.

states.loading: Centered spinner over a subtle brandTertiary background.
states.empty: Clean abstract illustration + 'Your financial memory starts here' + Primary Quick Record CTA.
states.error: Readable message ('Unable to load balance') + Retry button.

screens.layout: Use a featured hero card at the top displaying the Current Balance and Coverage Score over a premium textured background (with gradient scrim). Below it, display a 2-column grid for 'Money In/Out' and 'Blind Spots'. Use a floating FAB for 'Quick Record'.

screens.name: Money
screens.purpose: A comprehensive, filterable ledger of all financial transactions across all sources.

states.empty: Abstract geometric image + 'No transactions found' + Clear filters CTA.
states.error: Readable message ('Failed to sync transactions') + Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky header with horizontally scrollable filter chips (All, Bank, UPI, Card, Cash). Transaction list using a timeline-based view. Each row uses a tinted icon container for the category, title, source, and amount.

screens.name: Control
screens.purpose: A dedicated health dashboard mapping control effectiveness, coverage score, and blind spots.

states.empty: Illustration + 'Start capturing transactions to unlock your control score.'

screens.layout: Explicit health/control effectiveness scorecard at the top. Use stacked modules with visual indicators (risk level dots) for Unexplained Differences and Duplicates. Expandable/collapsible rows revealing health factor breakdowns.

screens.name: Upcoming
screens.purpose: A timeline of financial commitments, EMIs, and pending receivables.
screens.layout: Segmented control at the top (Upcoming, Recurring, Loans). Display commitments in wide cards showing amount, due date, and status. Use warm warning colors for imminent dues.

screens.name: Ask ARTHA
screens.purpose: A natural language conversational interface for financial insights, avoiding generic chatbot aesthetics.

states.loading: Subtle typing indicator or pulsing brand logo.
states.empty: Suggested query chips (e.g., 'How much did I spend on food this month?') + Large sticky microphone button.
states.error: Readable message ('ARTHA needs connection to think') + Retry button.

screens.layout: Chat interface with premium, rounded message bubbles. The bottom input area should feature a prominent voice/mic button for quick voice input. English/Hindi toggle visible in the header.

screens.name: Quick Record
screens.purpose: A fast, notes-app-inspired modal for capturing financial events instantly.

states.error: Validation error text inline under inputs.

screens.layout: Implemented as a full-bleed bottom sheet. Direct manual entry form with large, easily tappable inputs for Amount. Toggle for Paid/Received. Dropdowns/chips for Category and Account Source. Sticky 'Save' button above the keyboard.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do NOT use ANY blues (navy, sky, royal, etc.) or purples. Use the defined moss green and sage colors to communicate a premium financial feel.
Implement the 'Quick Record' as a globally accessible FAB from the Home screen, triggering a fast-entry bottom sheet to capture data swiftly.
Ensure the hero card on the Home screen uses the 'hero_background' image with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to ensure foreground text contrast.
Support English and Hindi (Devanagari script) cleanly by using the defined typography (PlusJakartaSans supports it well; ensure the UI scales correctly for Devanagari text heights).
For the 'Ask ARTHA' screen, avoid a generic chatbot UI. Make it look like a premium conversational insights layer with distinct typography, structured insight cards, and a prominent voice mic button.
Ensure all interactive touch targets (especially Quick Record FAB and bottom tabs) are at least 44x44pt.
For 'Money' transactions, utilize tinted icon containers (brandTertiary background with brandPrimary icon) for transaction categories instead of raw icons.
Include a Hindi language toggle prominently on the Home screen header or in a global settings modal accessible from the header.
Format currency strictly using the Indian Rupee (₹) symbol.
